name: Ashen Reaver
theme: A ruthless raider forged in fire and battle, using overwhelming aggression, brutal axe strikes, and relentless determination to break enemy lines.
visualIdentity: Charred armor plates, massive greataxe, bone trophies, dark leather bindings, ash-stained furs, scarred equipment, and restrained ember-red effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, greataxe design, armor silhouette, bone trophies, leather bindings, fur placement, and black, gray, ember-red, and ash palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Raging Onslaught
starterAbilities.description: Launch an aggressive assault with overwhelming momentum.

starterAbilities.name: Ashen Fury
starterAbilities.description: Channel burning rage into devastating attacks.

starterAbilities.name: Reaver's Cleave
starterAbilities.description: Deliver a sweeping attack capable of striking multiple foes.
